cards.ex: My grandfather used to spin yarns about his adventures as a sailor.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom dengizchi sifatidagi sarguzashtlari haqida ertaklar to'qirdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq va qiziqarli, lekin ko'pincha haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan hikoya aytish.

cards.ex: She voiced her opinion on the new policy at the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishda yangi siyosat bo'yicha o'z fikrini bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini omma oldida yoki biror kishiga aytish, ifodalash.

cards.ex: It's difficult to hold a conversation with him when he's constantly on his phone.
cards.exUz: U doimo telefonda bo'lganda u bilan suhbatlashish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Bir yoki bir necha kishi bilan gaplashish, suhbat qurish.

cards.ex: The language barrier made it difficult for us to understand each other.
cards.exUz: Til to'sig'i bizning bir-birimizni tushunishimizni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Turli tillarda gaplashadigan odamlar o'rtasidagi aloqa qiyinligi.

cards.ex: She relied on non-verbal cues to understand his feelings.
cards.exUz: U uning his-tuyg'ularini tushunish uchun so'zsiz signallarga tayanardi.
cards.uzDef: Gapirmasdan turib, imo-ishoralar, yuz ifodalari orqali beriladigan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The two politicians engaged in a war of words over the proposed legislation.
cards.exUz: Ikki siyosatchi taklif qilingan qonunchilik bo'yicha og'zaki urushga kirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq va bahsli bahs, ko'pincha ommaviy axborot vositalarida.

cards.ex: I put his lack of communication down to his busy schedule.
cards.exUz: Men uning aloqa qilmasligini bandligi bilan izohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababini shu narsaga bog'lash.

cards.ex: The two sides agreed to engage in dialogue to resolve the conflict.
cards.exUz: Ikki tomon mojaroni hal qilish uchun muloqotga kirishishga kelishib oldi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro fikr almashish, suhbatlashish.

cards.ex: Everyone should have their say on this important issue.
cards.exUz: Har bir kishi ushbu muhim masala bo'yicha o'z fikrini bildirish huquqiga ega bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini bildirish, biror narsa haqida gapirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Politics can be a delicate subject to discuss at family gatherings.
cards.exUz: Siyosat oilaviy yig'ilishlarda muhokama qilish uchun nozik mavzu bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bahslashish yoki muhokama qilish qiyin bo'lgan mavzu.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with what you said about the new policy.
cards.exUz: Men sizning yangi siyosat haqida aytganlaringizga e'tiroz bildiraman.
cards.uzDef: Birovning fikriga yoki harakatiga rozi bo'lmaslik, e'tiroz bildirish.

cards.ex: She knows me so well, she can read me like a book.
cards.exUz: U meni juda yaxshi biladi, u meni kitobdek o'qiy oladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning his-tuyg'ulari va fikrlarini osongina tushunish.

cards.ex: The situation was, to put it mildly, chaotic.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat, yumshoq qilib aytsak, tartibsizlik edi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni to'liq ifodalamasdan, yumshoqroq shaklda aytish.

cards.ex: He talks so much, it's hard to get a word in edgewise.
cards.exUz: U juda ko'p gapiradi, uning gap orasiga qo'shilish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Birov gapirayotganda o'z fikrini aytishga imkon topish.

cards.ex: The proposal sparked a heated debate in parliament.
cards.exUz: Taklif parlamentda qizg'in bahsga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq hissiyotlar bilan kechadigan, bahsli munozara.

cards.ex: The media often takes quotes out of context to create sensational headlines.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari ko'pincha shov-shuvli sarlavhalar yaratish uchun iqtiboslarni mazmunidan uzib oladi.
cards.uzDef: Gapni to'liq ma'nosini bermaydigan qilib, qisman keltirish.

cards.ex: His generosity was so overwhelming, words fail me.
cards.exUz: Uning saxovatpeshaligi shunchalik kuchliki, men so'z topolmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli his-tuyg'ular tufayli gapirishga so'z topa olmaslik.

cards.ex: We talked at length about the future of the company.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyaning kelajagi haqida batafsil gaplashdik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq va batafsil tarzda biror narsa haqida gapirish.

cards.ex: She told him, in no uncertain terms, that she wanted a divorce.
cards.exUz: U unga aniq va qat'iy qilib ajrashishni xohlashini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va tushunarli tarzda, hech qanday shubha qoldirmasdan.

cards.ex: I had to bite my tongue to avoid starting an argument.
cards.exUz: Men bahslashmaslik uchun tilingni tishlashga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni tutish, aytmoqchi bo'lgan narsani aytmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His comments were inappropriate; he really crossed the line.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari o'rinsiz edi; u chindan ham chegaradan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinadigan chegaralardan chiqish, odob doirasidan chiqish.

cards.ex: Whether he was right or wrong is now a moot point.
cards.exUz: Uning haq yoki noto'g'ri bo'lgani hozir bahsli nuqta.
cards.uzDef: Endi ahamiyati yo'q bo'lgan yoki hal qilingan masala.

cards.ex: We got off on the wrong foot during our first meeting.
cards.exUz: Biz birinchi uchrashuvimizda noto'g'ri boshladik.
cards.term: get off on the wrong foot
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni yomon boshlash, dastlab yaxshi taassurot qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: Let's get to the heart of the matter and discuss the budget.
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy masalaga o'taylik va byudjetni muhokama qilaylik.
cards.term: get to the heart of the matter
cards.uzDef: Asosiy muammo yoki mavzuga diqqatni qaratish.

cards.ex: He's a real go-getter, to coin a phrase.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy ishbilarmon, ibora yaratadigan bo'lsak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ibora yoki so'z birikmasini yaratish.

cards.ex: He's known for shooting from the hip, which sometimes gets him into trouble.
cards.exUz: U o'ylab o'tirmay gapirishi bilan tanilgan, bu ba'zan uni muammoga solib qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylab o'tirmay, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapirish, rejalashtirmasdan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: That's a loaded question, designed to make me look bad.
cards.exUz: Bu meni yomon ko'rsatish uchun mo'ljallangan hiylali savol.
cards.uzDef: Yashirin ma'noga ega bo'lgan, javob berish qiyin bo'lgan savol.

cards.ex: Don't mince your words, just tell me what you really think.
cards.exUz: Iboralarni tanlamang, menga nima deb o'ylayotganingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay yoki xafa qiladigan narsani aytmaslik uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan gapirish.

cards.ex: The whole team needs to sing from the same hymn sheet if we want to succeed.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsak, butun jamoa bir xil fikrda bo'lishi kerak.
cards.term: sing from the same hymn sheet
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, kelishib harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I take exception to the way you spoke to my colleague.
cards.exUz: Men sizning hamkasbim bilan qanday gaplashganingizga rozi emasman.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga qarshi bo'lish, norozi bo'lish.
